Name: Street
CurrentDescription: Payout: +1 VP per adjacent building, counted once across your Streets.
ProposedDescription: Payout: +1 VP per building adjacent to your Streets. Count each building once.
Decision: Keep. Any owner's building counts; only this road type pays recurring VP.

Name: House
CurrentDescription: Payout: +1 coin per Shop within 2 tiles (max 2; Shop capacity applies). Place: +1 VP per adjacent house.
ProposedDescription: Place: +1 VP per adjacent Home building. Payout: +1 coin if a Shop is within 2 tiles.
Decision: Replace linking with one independent condition; generalize Home adjacency to the tag.

Name: Cottage
CurrentDescription: Payout: +1 coin beside a Park or Lake. Place: +1 VP per adjacent park. No Links.
ProposedDescription: Place: +1 VP per adjacent park tile or Lake. Payout: +1 coin if adjacent to a park tile or Lake.
Decision: Keep. A Lake's own payout can give this Cottage another coin. Remove No Links.

Name: Shop
CurrentDescription: Payout: +1 coin per house within 2 tiles (max 3; house capacity applies), and +1 for a Farm within 3. Both owners earn a coin.
ProposedDescription: Payout: +1 coin per Home building within 2 tiles, max 3.
Decision: Independent count; remove shared capacity, both-owner payment and Farm supply bonus.

Name: Farm
CurrentDescription: Links to up to 3 Shops within 3 tiles. Each adjacent Farm pays both owners +1 coin.
ProposedDescription: Payout: +1 coin if adjacent to another Farm or Orchard.
Decision: Replace Farm-Shop and Farm-Farm linking with one condition. Nature tag stays.

Name: Park
CurrentDescription: Joins and scores the connected park.
ProposedDescription: Park size 1. Place: score the park's increase.
Decision: Use new shared Park help rule; owner-only marginal scoring capped at size 10.

Name: Wild Garden
CurrentDescription: A park tile of size 1. Can start or bridge parks.
ProposedDescription: Park size 1. Place: score the park's increase.
Decision: Same mechanics as Park. Keep as art variant for now; it has no exclusive bridging power.

Name: Grant
CurrentDescription: +4 coins now, then discard.
ProposedDescription: Play: gain 4 coins, then discard this card.
Decision: Keep initially. Costs a market opportunity; Common purchase gives a nominal 3-coin gain.

Name: Avenue
CurrentDescription: Road worth 2 tiles for Longest Road. Payout: +1 coin beside at least 2 buildings.
ProposedDescription: Counts as 2 tiles for Longest Road. Payout: +1 coin if adjacent to at least 2 buildings.
Decision: Keep. Does not receive Street's recurring VP rule.

Name: Roundabout
CurrentDescription: Your Roundabout scores +1 VP whenever anyone places a building beside it.
ProposedDescription: When anyone builds beside this: gain 1 VP.
Decision: Keep. Buildings only; roads and events do not trigger it. No retroactive award.

Name: Orchard
CurrentDescription: A Farm that also counts as a park tile.
ProposedDescription: Park size 1. Place: score the park's increase. Payout: +1 coin if adjacent to a Farm or another Orchard.
Decision: Explicit independent Farm role plus new Park rule. Retain Nature only.

Name: Lake
CurrentDescription: Not a park; adjacent houses earn +1 coin and count it as a park neighbour.
ProposedDescription: Payout: each adjacent Home building earns its owner 1 coin. Counts as a park neighbor, but is not a park tile.
Decision: Keep payout; standardize to Home tag. Never joins a park region.

Name: Vineyard
CurrentDescription: Pays nothing for 2 payouts, then +3 coins each payout.
ProposedDescription: Payout: nothing for its first 2 payouts; then +3 coins each payout.
Decision: Keep timing/amount initially; force early/late tests. Zero plays in baseline.

Name: Startup
CurrentDescription: Payout: +1, then +2, then +3 coins, remaining at +3.
ProposedDescription: Payout: +1 coin the first time, +2 the second, then +3 each time.
Decision: Keep ramp; force timing tests. Zero plays is not proof of weakness.

Name: Market
CurrentDescription: Payout: +1 coin per own Shop within 2 tiles (max 4).
ProposedDescription: Payout: +1 coin per Shop you own within 2 tiles, max 4.
Decision: Keep. Shop card only, not every Trade building. Force engine scenario.

Name: Contractor
CurrentDescription: +1 coin when you place a House or Shop, up to 2 per round.
ProposedDescription: When you build a House card or Shop: gain 1 coin, up to 2 coins per round.
Decision: Keep the specific-card restriction; Apartment and Cottage do not trigger it.

Name: Apartment
CurrentDescription: Payout: Counts as 2 houses for nearby Shops. Place: +2 VP per adjacent Home building.
ProposedDescription: Place: +2 VP per adjacent Home building. Payout: +2 coins if a Shop is within 2 tiles.
Decision: State its own income. Remove counts-as-two and capacity allocation.

Name: Cafe
CurrentDescription: Payout: +1 coin per adjacent house or shop (max 3). End: +2 VP beside a park.
ProposedDescription: Payout: +1 coin per adjacent Home building or Shop, max 3. End: +2 VP if adjacent to a park tile or Lake.
Decision: Direct count, no link object. Preserve Lake bonus; standardize Home tag.

Name: Fountain
CurrentDescription: A park tile of size 2.
ProposedDescription: Park size 2. Place: score the park's increase.
Decision: Keep size, replace repeated region scoring.

Name: Factory
CurrentDescription: Payout: +2 coins. End: adjacent houses and cafes lose 1 VP, including yours.
ProposedDescription: Payout: +2 coins. End: each adjacent Home building or Cafe loses its owner 1 VP, including yours.
Decision: Keep amount and stacking pollution; standardize Home tag. Test with total build cost.

Name: Sapling
CurrentDescription: Park size 1. After 2 payouts grows into a Forest of size 3 and scores the park.
ProposedDescription: Park size 1. Place: score the park's increase. After its second payout, grows to size 3 and scores the increase again.
Decision: Use marginal size increase; Forest is a mature state, not another draw.

Name: Bank
CurrentDescription: Payout: +2 coins. Stackable, max 3.
ProposedDescription: Payout: +2 coins.
Decision: Keep as reference income card; separate requirement line says limit 3.

Name: Town Hall
CurrentDescription: Payout: +2 coins if you own at least 3 Civic-tagged buildings, including this.
ProposedDescription: Payout: +2 coins if you own at least 3 Civic buildings, including this.
Decision: Keep threshold. Civic means tag, not card type.

Name: Museum
CurrentDescription: End: +1 VP per other Culture building you own (max 8).
ProposedDescription: End: +1 VP per other Culture building you own, max 8.
Decision: Keep. Excludes itself; force Culture scenario.

Name: Chamber of Commerce
CurrentDescription: Payout: +1 coin per 2 Trade buildings you own (max 4).
ProposedDescription: Payout: +1 coin per 2 Trade buildings you own, max 4 coins. Includes this.
Decision: Keep threshold/cap; zero plays requires targeted coverage.

Name: Warehouse
CurrentDescription: Gain a Street at round start. The first Street you place each round pays +1 coin.
ProposedDescription: Round start: gain a Street if your hand has room. When you build your first Street each round: gain 1 coin.
Decision: Keep. Default arrives next round; generated Streets may be especially strong when money is scarce.

Name: Builders' Yard
CurrentDescription: Gain a Street or random Common of your choice at round start.
ProposedDescription: Round start: gain a Street or a random Common, if your hand has room. Choose which before the round starts.
Decision: Keep. Choice is Street versus random Common, not selecting a specific Common. Defaults to Street.

Name: Hospital
CurrentDescription: The nearest Hospital within 4 tiles of an emergency scores +1 VP.
ProposedDescription: Each round: one random Home building has an emergency. The nearest Hospital within 4 tiles earns its owner 1 VP. Ties go to the earlier Hospital.
Decision: Standardize emergency eligibility to Home tag; no emergency when none exist. Keep award/range; force coverage.

Name: Tourist Office
CurrentDescription: Payout: +1 coin per own Culture building (max 3).
ProposedDescription: Payout: +1 coin per Culture building you own, max 3. Includes this.
Decision: Keep. Self-count means at least 1 while owned.

Name: Tax Office
CurrentDescription: Payout: +1 coin per 4 own houses.
ProposedDescription: Payout: +1 coin per 4 Home buildings you own.
Decision: Unify residential-only predicate to Home tag. No cap currently; monitor large cities.

Name: Depot
CurrentDescription: Payout: +1 coin per 5 own road tiles (max 4).
ProposedDescription: Payout: +1 coin per 5 road tiles you own, max 4 coins.
Decision: Keep physical-card count. Avenue counts once here, twice only for Longest Road.

Name: School
CurrentDescription: Payout: +1 coin per own house within 2 tiles (max 4).
ProposedDescription: Payout: +1 coin per Home building you own within 2 tiles, max 4.
Decision: Standardize residential-only predicate to Home tag. School is not Home and cannot count itself.

Name: Granary
CurrentDescription: Payout: +1 coin per own Shop without a Farm Link.
ProposedDescription: Payout: +1 coin per Farm or Orchard you own, max 3.
Decision: Replace unsupplied-Shop calculation; no supply status remains.

Name: Stadium
CurrentDescription: Adjacent houses gain a coin and Cafes lose one each payout. End: +1 VP per adjacent house.
ProposedDescription: Payout: each adjacent Home building earns its owner 1 coin; each adjacent Cafe loses its owner 1 coin. End: +1 VP per adjacent Home building.
Decision: Keep amounts, any owner; standardize Home tag. No debt; payout deductions can use saved coins.

Name: Airport
CurrentDescription: Payout: +3 coins. End: each house within 2 loses 1 VP, capped at 3 per player across Airports.
ProposedDescription: Payout: +3 coins. End: each Home building within 2 tiles loses its owner 1 VP. Maximum loss: 3 VP per player across all Airports.
Decision: Keep combined penalty cap, standardize Home tag. Test income after total cost.

Name: Skyscraper
CurrentDescription: Place beside at least 2 buildings. End: +1 VP per building within 2 tiles (max 6).
ProposedDescription: Requires at least 2 adjacent buildings. End: +1 VP per other building within 2 tiles, max 6.
Decision: Keep. Any owner qualifies. Show buildability before purchase; none played in baseline.

Name: Industrial Estate
CurrentDescription: Payout: +1 coin per Industry building you own, including this (max 5).
ProposedDescription: Payout: +1 coin per Industry building you own, max 5. Includes this.
Decision: Keep Industry TAG count. Farms and Orchards do not count.

Name: Housing Authority
CurrentDescription: End: +1 VP per 3 Home buildings you own, including this (max 6).
ProposedDescription: End: +1 VP per 3 Home buildings you own, max 6. Includes this.
Decision: Keep thresholds; it also counts for the prototype's general Home interactions.

Name: Eco Council
CurrentDescription: End: +1 VP per 2 Nature buildings you own (max 8), minus 2 per Industry building (min 0).
ProposedDescription: End: +1 VP per 2 Nature buildings you own, max 8; then subtract 2 VP per Industry building you own, minimum 0. Includes this in Nature.
Decision: Keep cap-before-penalty order; Industry tag only. Do not give Farm an Industry tag.

Name: Gardener's Guild
CurrentDescription: +1 coin whenever you place a park tile.
ProposedDescription: When you build a park tile: gain 1 coin.
Decision: Keep placement-only trigger; no coin for Sapling growth. Test after park nerf.

Name: Architect's Studio
CurrentDescription: Your first building each round pays +2 coins if placed beside your own building.
ProposedDescription: When you build your first building each round beside one of your buildings: gain 2 coins. This Studio can trigger its own effect.
Decision: Keep self-trigger. If first building fails the condition, a later building does not qualify.

Name: Renovation
CurrentDescription: Replace one of your non-road buildings with a different building card from your hand.
ProposedDescription: Play: replace one of your buildings with a different building card from your hand. Discard both cards. Pay the new building's build cost.
Decision: No roads/events as replacement or target. Keep earned VP; new age and placement effects apply. Build charge is new.

Name: Ribbon Cutting
CurrentDescription: +1 coin per building you placed this round (max 4).
ProposedDescription: Play: gain 1 coin per building you built this round, max 4, then discard this card.
Decision: Keep first trial; at new Uncommon price 3 only net +1 at cap. Consider Common weight 1 if focused tests confirm weakness.

Name: Rush Hour
CurrentDescription: Your Links pay +1 coin this payout (max 8).
ProposedDescription: Play: this payout, gain 1 extra coin per Shop you own, max 4. Discard this card. Once per round.
Decision: Replace Link bonus. One-round nonstacking effect, not permanent income.

Name: Land Claim
CurrentDescription: Reserve an empty tile against other players until next round.
ProposedDescription: Play: reserve an empty tile until next round starts. Only you may build there. Discard this card.
Decision: Keep tactical role; costs a purchase opportunity and does not stop rivals building elsewhere.

Name: Central Station
CurrentDescription: Payout: +1 coin per Link you receive (max 6).
ProposedDescription: Payout: +1 coin per Shop or Market you own, max 4.
Decision: Replace received Links. Does not count itself. Validate Legendary total price against other engines.

Name: Senate
CurrentDescription: End: +2 VP per tag on at least 3 own buildings (max 12).
ProposedDescription: End: +2 VP for each tag you have on at least 3 buildings, max 12. Includes this.
Decision: Keep six-tag scoring; buildings can qualify for multiple tags.

Name: Monument
CurrentDescription: End: +6 VP. No payout.
ProposedDescription: End: +6 VP.
Decision: Keep flat VP. No income; compare all-in Legendary price against Station and Senate.
